description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'Address' within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin module, specifically handling customer address management functions such as viewing, adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving addresses.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer addresses in the admin panel of OpenCart, providing methods for displaying address list, form, saving, deleting, and fetching address data via AJAX.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads customer language and displays the address list view.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a specific customer and renders the address list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address form for adding or editing an address, populating data as needed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of address data, including validation and permission checks, responding with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer address after permission check, responds with JSON.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns address info in JSON format for AJAX requests.
